name: C1 an overlapping utterance is dropped again instead of queued
expect: queues an overlapping final prompt and runs it as the next turn

name: C2 the voice retrieval failure stops telling the model memory could not be read
find: text: `[Memory could not be read this turn (${reason}). Do not answer from memory as if it were checked; say the lookup failed and ask Sid to repeat it if it matters.]`,
expect: starts a voice model with recorded empty context at the hard 750 millisecond retrieval deadline

name: C3 a pin digits request no longer asks the call for digits
expect: asks the call for four digits only when the model chose pin digits

name: C4 the owner agent stops dispatching owner_access to the call
replace: const result = Object.freeze({ outcome: "listed" as const, operation: "list" as const, maskedTarget: null, noticeUnconfirmed: false });
expect: dispatches owner_access with the model's arguments

name: C5 the model's pin choice is ignored in favour of the default
expect: asks the call for four digits only when the model chose pin digits
